components.purpose: Image-backed, two-line faceted 3D graph entity with type-specific geometry, semantic state, and an offset depth plane.

components.purpose: Stored disruptions modeled separately from the baseline.

components.name: Human Proposal Boundary
components.purpose: Keeps agent drafts reversible until a visible human decision.

narrative.overview: A severe near-black operational field makes evidence, ownership, and causal motion legible. Monochrome editorial imagery and faceted code-native geometry turn each entity into a spatial object without becoming a neon dashboard.
rules: Baseline, scenario, and proposal are always explicit separate states.
The graph camera can never leave the viewport blank.
Manual edits apply now; agent edits are staged for human review.
Vermilion and amber are the only semantic accents and are paired with text, structure, or motion.
Mobile retains both the graph and a visible accessible list.
